content:
For a random permutation of 7 elements, the expected number of cycles is

\[
\sum_{k=1}^{7}\frac1k=\frac{363}{140}.
\]

Thus the total number of cycles over all \(7!\) permutations is

\[
7!\cdot \frac{363}{140}=5040\cdot \frac{363}{140}=13068.
\]

Since \(f(\sigma)=7-c(\sigma)\),

\[
\sum_{\sigma} f(\sigma)
=7\cdot 7!-\sum_{\sigma} c(\sigma)
=35280-13068
=22212.
\]

\[
\boxed{22212}
\]
